map_readings.label: ROAD CLOSURE - NO MOTORIZED VEHICLE ACCESS
map_readings.shows: Legend entry: a red dot with a red line marks a road closure with no motorized vehicle access. Four such red dots are drawn on the map; none of the red closed roads has a name or km label printed on it.

map_readings.label: Loveland Bay Rd
map_readings.shows: Red road-closure dot on the road labelled Loveland Bay Rd, just south-west of where Brewster Lake Rd is printed, on the north edge of the no camping area; no red closed-road line is drawn from this dot.

map_readings.label: Loveland Bay Rd
map_readings.shows: Red road-closure dot at the north-west corner of the no camping area, on the road along the no camping area boundary that carries the Loveland Bay Rd label further north-east (the label is not printed at the dot); an unnamed road drawn in red runs from this dot south and then east to the shore of John Hart Lake.

map_readings.label: C A M P B E L L
map_readings.shows: Red road-closure dot beside the printed word CAMPBELL (river), at the edge of the no camping area; unnamed roads drawn in red run from it north-west into the no camping area along the John Hart Lake shore and a short way east.

Red road-closure dot with no words printed beside it, on an unnamed road just north of the transmission line and north-west of where John Hart Rd is printed; an unnamed road drawn in red runs from it north-west to the red roads near CAMPBELL.

map_readings.label: JOHN HART LAKE NO CAMPING AREA - DAY USE ONLY
map_readings.shows: Hatched area with a dark grey outline around John Hart Lake: no camping, day use only.

quotes.quote: By Order of the Province of British Columbia, October 15, 2001
ROAD CLOSURE - NO MOTORIZED VEHICLE ACCESS
